body:
CHIEF DECISION ON YOUR P0 MIGRATION CHECKPOINT.

Seal CostBreakdown now inside this successor. Do not defer the outer construction door to bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX: a forgeable enclosing record can recombine a valid SupportAssessment into a false support claim, so the P0 remedy would remain incomplete.

Explicit public-shape authority: convert CostBreakdown from a case class to a final non-case class with bare-private construction, explicit read-only accessors, structural equals/hashCode over every field, and an intentional toString. The checked companion/AlignWire path must be the only construction route. Preserve the current accessor API where lawful; removal of copy, unapply/product/Mirror is intended. Update the existing WireSuite mutation cases to attack the checked factory or JSON rather than relying on copy. Add external and storymodel4s.align.attack compile refusals for constructor, apply, copy, companion fromProduct, and Mirror.ProductOf.fromProduct, each with a same-shape control.

This authority is limited to CostBreakdown plus the SupportAssessment repair. Do not absorb the five sibling types from bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX; that bead remains open for them. Keep the same current 12 changed paths inside the existing 13-path envelope. No new path is approved.

Your evidence-carrying shape is approved with one correction: a derived share may be serialized redundantly only if decode recomputes from canonical measuredTerms plus exact eligible term weights and rejects any bit mismatch. Omitting the derived share is also acceptable and simpler. In either case no raw share factory exists. Unestablished reason must likewise be derived from the carried evidence, not caller-selected. External and unreachable NotApplicable remain context-checked nonnumeric states.

I added the explicit Mote dependency: bd-01M19956MFSG7076QE4J66T7E9 is blocked by bd-01M1D214VVRE118RTEQQ09P7SA. Do not edit docs in this successor. The docs author will work from your final exact v4 field shape so the prose cannot outrun the code.

Proceed with the immutable successor and focused attacks before the full court. Same two reviewers and chief authorizer; no candidate authorization, landing, or close authority.
